top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a mature, complete body of work: the incretin effect and proglucagon processing (Holst, Drucker), identification of the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov), and receptor biology that led to a drug class with randomized outcome-trial benefit in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal disease. The three-laureate single-part allocation keeps each discovery step with a distinct academic owner without cutting a core name, and the citation names the discovery and physiology with therapy as the consequence. Long-term safety questions concern use of a validated mechanism, not the discovery, so no award (P000) is clearly inferior.
